paper_title: An analysis of vaccine-related sentiments from development to deployment   of COVID-19 vaccines
caption: : Polarity scores for Japan
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the distribution of polarity scores for Japan, showing the count of scores across a range of values. The x-axis is labeled "Polarity scores" and has a linear scale, ranging from -1.1 to 0.6 with a tick label interval of 0.2. The y-axis is labeled "Counts" and also has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 40,000 with a tick label interval of 10,000. A single blue line with circular markers is plotted, starting at approximately 1,000 counts at a polarity score of -1.1, remaining relatively stable until -0.6 where it increases to around 5,000 counts, then decreases slightly to 3,000 counts at -0.4 before rising sharply to a peak of around 41,000 counts at a polarity score of 0.0, followed by a decline to 9,000 counts at 0.1, a secondary peak of 26,000 counts at 0.2, and then fluctuating to end at around 1,000 counts at a polarity score of 0.6.
